mapper.insert: INSERT INTO products (name, description, category_id, price, market_price, cost_price, sku, barcode, image, gallery, detail, status, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{name}, #{description}, #{categoryId}, #{price}, #{marketPrice}, #{costPrice}, #{sku}, #{barcode}, #{image}, #{gallery}, #{detail}, #{status}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM products WHERE id = #{id}
SELECT * FROM products WHERE sku = #{sku}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM products WHERE category_id = #{categoryId}
SELECT * FROM products WHERE status = 1 ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT * FROM products WHERE status = 1 ORDER BY CASE WHEN created_at >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 7 DAY) THEN 1 ELSE 2 END, id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT * FROM products WHERE status = 1 AND created_at >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 30 DAY) ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT * FROM products WHERE status = 1 AND market_price > price AND market_price - price > 0 ORDER BY (market_price - price) DESC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT * FROM products WHERE category_id = #{categoryId} AND status = 1 ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{limit}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM products WHERE category_id = #{categoryId} AND status = 1
SELECT * FROM products WHERE category_id = #{categoryId} AND id != #{productId} AND status = 1 ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT * FROM products WHERE status = 1 AND ( name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR description LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR sku LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR barcode LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') ) ORDER BY CASE WHEN name LIKE CONCAT(#{keyword}, '%') THEN 1 WHEN name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') THEN 2 ELSE 3 END, id DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{limit}

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM products WHERE status = 1 AND ( name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR description LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR sku LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR barcode LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') )

SELECT p.*, pi.quantity as stock_quantity FROM products p LEFT JOIN product_inventory pi ON p.id = pi.product_id WHERE p.status = 1 AND pi.quantity <= #{threshold} ORDER BY pi.quantity ASC LIMIT #{offset}, #{limit}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM products p LEFT JOIN product_inventory pi ON p.id = pi.product_id WHERE p.status = 1 AND pi.quantity <= #{threshold}

SELECT COUNT(*) as total_products, COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 1 THEN 1 END) as active_products, COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 0 THEN 1 END) as inactive_products, AVG(price) as average_price, MIN(price) as min_price, MAX(price) as max_price FROM products

SELECT c.id as category_id, c.name as category_name, COUNT(p.id) as product_count, AVG(p.price) as average_price FROM categories c LEFT JOIN products p ON c.id = p.category_id AND p.status = 1 GROUP BY c.id, c.name ORDER BY product_count DESC

SELECT CASE WHEN price < 50 THEN '0-50' WHEN price BETWEEN 50 AND 100 THEN '50-100' WHEN price BETWEEN 100 AND 200 THEN '100-200' WHEN price BETWEEN 200 AND 500 THEN '200-500' WHEN price BETWEEN 500 AND 1000 THEN '500-1000' ELSE '1000+' END as price_range, COUNT(*) as product_count FROM products WHERE status = 1 GROUP BY price_range ORDER BY CASE price_range WHEN '0-50' THEN 1 WHEN '50-100' THEN 2 WHEN '100-200' THEN 3 WHEN '200-500' THEN 4 WHEN '500-1000' THEN 5 ELSE 6 END
